main: Use case: stylized-concept. Single production UI texture ATLAS, square 2048x2048, TRANSPARENT background, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows equal cells, each object centered fully inside its cell with generous 12% transparent padding, absolutely no text or labels. Match the attached Roblox simulator references: polished candy glossy illustrated 3D game icons, VERY bold nearly black navy contour, crisp white shine, saturated cyan hot pink gold lime, dimensional bevels, hand-painted highlights. Camera is slight three-quarter front, each icon large readable silhouette. Row 1 left to right: hot-pink shopping basket with cyan handle; pink and icy-cyan circular rebirth arrows; electric cyan and violet flame surrounding golden core (aura); cute square orange puppy with big glossy eyes and tiny ears. Row 2: black-and-white SOCCER BALL flying diagonally with purple-magenta flame comet trail; caramel leather backpack; cyan gift box with lavish golden ribbon; golden lightning bolt. Row 3: golden trophy cup; red calendar with white sheet and blue binder rings but NO numerals; cyan clock with golden lightning; bright red rounded-square close button with white X. Row 4: plain black-white SOCCER BALL; glossy pale blue egg; cyan star-shaped glass boost potion with gold stopper; magnificent golden shooting star with cyan comet ribbons. Each cell contains exactly one specified icon, no scenery, no cast shadow outside object, no border enclosing cells, no grid lines. This image is an atlas intended to crop cells in Roblox. Do not repeat or merge objects.
